title: Backlog — Ticket
description: One structured, vertically-sliced ticket from the Step-4 backlog. Meets the Definition of Ready: identity, testable acceptance criteria, known dependencies, and a verification approach. A ticket carries either a `goal` (task) or a `story` (story).

id.description: Ticket id '<PREFIX>-<n>' (project tag, not CM-). Enabler tasks use a 1xx band.

epic.description: The epic id this ticket belongs to (matches roadmap.json).

type.description: Ticket type. task -> uses `goal`; story -> uses `story`.

subtype.description: Optional. 'enabler' marks a task that exists to unblock stories (data model, riskiest-assumption ticket).

spec.description: Relative path to the /spec this ticket was sliced from.

spec_step.description: Optional. Which numbered plan step in the spec this ticket implements.

depends_on.description: Ticket ids that must be done first (dependency order). Empty array if none.

blocks.description: Ticket ids this one unblocks. Empty array if none.

goal.description: Task only: one-sentence goal of the ticket.

story.description: Story only: 'As a <user>, I want <capability>, so that <benefit>.'

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable conditions that define done. Each is independently checkable.

verification.description: How the ticket is proven — usually naming a ladder rung (e.g. 'property tests -> test rung').

decision_to_record.description: Optional. A decision this ticket pins down (e.g. the riskiest-assumption rule). Free-form: a string, or a structured object capturing the rule and its rationale.

plan.description: Optional inline Plan beat for gnarly tickets — approach, ordered steps, and risks. Captured early; shape is intentionally loose.

notes.description: Optional supplementary notes, slicing rationale, or non-goals.
